    Source and assumptions

    • Drawings: dys architecture, Showroom Renovation, preliminary issue for review 28 Sep 2026 (drawings dated 25 Aug 2026): site and key plan A0.01, demolition plan A1.01, plan A1.02, floor plans A2.01 to A2.03, finishes plans A2.04 and A2.05, ramp details A7.01. The set is marked preliminary, for review only.
    • Drawn: the tenant-improvement footprint, walls, glazing lines, columns, room layout and numbers, counters, the raised platform extents and its +3'-0" height, the two ramps, and the positions of the 24 vehicles on plan, all traced from the floor plan A2.01 at 3/32" = 1'-0". The existing building outline and the lot come from the key plan.
    • Assumed or indicative: no sections or elevations are in the set, so heights are assumed: clear height 4.5 m, a 0.35 m roof slab, curtain wall to 4.05 m, partitions 3.0 m, glass partitions 2.75 m, and the existing building at 6.4 m. The cover sheet lists three storeys; only the level in scope is modelled, as one storey. Finish schedules on A2.04 and A2.05 read "XX / TBC", so floor, wall and cladding colours are placeholders. The traced footprint is about 2,160 m² against the 2,113 m² stated on the cover sheet, and the existing building is modelled to the key plan outline. Doors, stairs, desks, vehicle shapes, the entrance canopy, parked cars in the lot and street trees are simplified stand-ins.
    • Existing condition and demolition: the original layout is rebuilt from the demolition plan A1.01 and the demolition reflected ceiling plan A1.02: the partitions, glazed hall, counters and millwork, guardrails and handrails, concrete platform stairs and ramp, window wall, overhead doors, flooring, baseboards and ceilings marked for removal. Footprints are traced from the vector linework of those sheets (about 55 partition runs and 21 doors, the glazed hall with its double doors, the CMU shear wall, 46 millwork outlines, the stairs, ramps and landings, the north curtain wall at its drawn 2.45 ft mullion spacing, and the south window wall and curb). Heights, stair and ramp rises, door leaves and ceiling levels are assumed, because the sheets are plans only.
    • Construction timeline: illustrative only. The drawings say what is removed and what is built, not when or in what order. The 28 weeks on the scrubber (6 of demolition, 1 clean shell, 21 of tenant improvement) and the order of trades are an assumed sequence for presentation, not a contractor's programme.
    • Left out: neighbouring properties, services, signage, structure above the ceiling and landscape detail.
